Step 3 needs two changes to `specs/deferred_items.md`. Your partner has already decided both, so I would make them without asking.

The drafted closure note names follow-up work (SMS batching), so it needs an `→ item:` marker and a real backlog item. The "batch size of 50 stays until the mail host rejects a batch" sentence is a deferral too, so it becomes a watch item. I also put the note on one line, since a note must sit on a single line.

<edit path="specs/deferred_items.md">
Replace the first entry of `## 11-overdue-notices — 2026-10-02`:

- [x] Reminder e-mails open one SMTP connection per message, so the nightly
      run takes about 40 minutes for 9,000 loans. See
      specs/plans/completed/11-overdue-notices.md; touches notices/mailer.py.
      → done in plan 15. Batching covers e-mail only; SMS reminders still make one gateway call per message → item: 15-reminder-batching — 2026-10-30

Append at the end of the file, after the `13-branch-hours` section:

## 15-reminder-batching — 2026-10-30
- [ ] SMS reminders still make one gateway call per message; plan 15 batched
      e-mail only. Your partner wants this next. See
      specs/plans/completed/15-reminder-batching.md for the e-mail batching to
      mirror. Size: plan. Done when: SMS reminders go out through the gateway
      in batches, one call per batch, with a test that fails on a per-message
      call.
- [ ] E-mail batch size is fixed at 50 (plan 15, owner ruled it stays). See
      specs/plans/completed/15-reminder-batching.md; touches the e-mail
      batching in notices/mailer.py. Size: quick-fix. Revisit if: the mail
      host rejects a batch with `421 Too many messages`.
</edit>

No commands are needed for this step. The edits land with the protocol's other commits.

**Message to your partner:**

Step 3 of the completion protocol is done:

- **Ticked:** the per-message SMTP item from `11-overdue-notices` is now `- [x] … → done in plan 15`.
- **Marker added:** the closure note says SMS isn't batched yet and carries `→ item: 15-reminder-batching — 2026-10-30`, so it points at a real backlog item.
- **New section `15-reminder-batching — 2026-10-30`, two items:**
  1. **SMS batching:** Size: plan, with a Done-when that SMS goes out one gateway call per batch. You said it's next, so it has no `Revisit if:` and it will age like normal work.
  2. **Batch size of 50:** a watch item whose single signal is the mail host rejecting a batch with `421 Too many messages`. It doesn't age.

Please check one thing. I didn't know where the SMS sender lives, so that item names no file for it. I took `notices/mailer.py` for the batch-size item from the original entry, and I'd confirm both against plan 15's diff before committing.

Next is step 4, the backlog stats and triage report.
